title: Supply Chain Manager — Daily Order Tracking & Supplier Follow-Up
description:
We are a US based ecom store doing 30 to 40 orders a day. Our products

ship from China and we promise our customers delivery within 14 days.

We hit that most of the time. We want to hit it every time.



We are looking for one experienced person to own that.



Being in the Philippines is an advantage for this role, because our

supplier is in China and you will be messaging them during their

working hours.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Open our tracking sheet every day and check what moved and what did not.

- Find every parcel where the supplier created a shipping label but never

  actually handed the parcel to the carrier. This is our single biggest

  problem and it is invisible unless someone looks for it every day.

- Message our supplier on WhatsApp with order numbers and tracking numbers,

  and keep asking until you get a concrete answer instead of a promise.

- Run a strict
 cycle on every open issue: first message, follow up

  after 3 days, final follow up 2 days later. After 8 days we refund the

  customer and stop waiting.

- Handle product issues, customs holds, failed deliveries and returns.

- Log every issue in the right tab so nothing gets handled twice and

  nothing gets forgotten.

- Request photos and video from our supplier for every product that passes

  30 units sold, and ask for a price reduction at the same time.

- Post a request in Slack when a customer needs to be
ed. You will not

 
 customers yourself. Our customer service team does that.



HOW WE MEASURE YOU



Seven numbers, calculated automatically in the sheet, reviewed together

every Friday:



1. Average delivery time: under 14 days

2. Orders past our promise, as a share of all open orders: under 5 percent

3. Labels made but never scanned, older than 5 days: 0

4. Orders unfulfilled longer than 24 hours: 0

5. Open tickets where the first
 was never sent: 0

6. Tickets open longer than 8 days with no refund: 0

7. Products past 30 units sold without a quality check: 0



Five of those seven should always be zero. They do not measure how good

you are, they measure whether you did the work. We will both be looking

at the same screen.



WHAT YOU NEED



- Proven experience in e-commerce fulfilment or supply chain. This is not

  an entry level role. If this would be your first e-commerce job, please

  do not apply.

- Experience dealing with Chinese suppliers or fulfilment agents.

- You understand what tracking data actually tells you, and specifically

  the difference between a label being created and a parcel being handed

  to a carrier.

- Clear written English. You will be writing to a supplier who is not a

  native speaker, so short and precise beats polished.

- Comfortable in Google Sheets. You do not need to build anything.

  Everything is already built, colour coded and documented.

- The discipline to do this every single day, including Saturday.

  Parcels do not pause.

- The backbone to keep asking a supplier the same question until you

  get a real answer.



HOW TO APPLY



Watch this short video before you apply. It is under 3 minutes.

I explain the role myself, and at the end I tell you exactly what

I need you to include in your message.







I only read applications from people who watched it.

title: Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
Growth Marketing Specialist



About eXpand AD

eXpand AD is a growth marketing agency serving B2B businesses across the United States and Canada. We help businesses generate qualified leads, acquire customers, and strengthen their digital presence.





Position Overview

The Growth Marketing Specialist manages content marketing, GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM operations, lead generation, and sales execution for eXpand AD and its clients. The role also includes social media management, reporting, and basic website support.



Key Responsibilities



1. Content Marketing and Social Media

Produce at least 5 complete content packages per week for eXpand AD and its clients.

Develop content concepts and calendars aligned with client briefs, brand guidelines, target audiences, and marketing objectives.

Create copy, graphics, carousels, short-form videos, captions, and calls to action.

Adapt approved content for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.

Use Canva and AI tools to support content production.

Schedule and publish approved content; monitor reach, engagement, clicks, inquiries, and leads where measurable.

Support WordPress publishing and basic SEO and generative engine optimization (GEO).

Maintain organized content files and publication schedules.

Content package definition: One campaign-ready deliverable containing the relevant concept, copy, creative assets or video, captions, and calls to action as appropriate. Repurposing the same package across platforms does not count as an additional package. Five packages is the weekly minimum, not a maximum.



2. GoHighLevel CRM and Automation

Maintain accurate contacts, lead sources, pipeline stages, tasks, and follow-up dates.

Manage opportunities from initial lead entry through closed-won or closed-lost status.

Configure and maintain approved workflows, calendars,
 sequences, and basic automations.

Investigate failed actions, duplicate messages, and missed follow-ups.

Ensure active opportunities have a documented status and next step.

Update CRM records within one business day of relevant activity.

Improve pipeline visibility, automation reliability, and follow-up processes.

Support approved client CRM tasks within the assigned scope.



3. Sales and Customer Acquisition

Research businesses and decision-makers in the United States and Canada.

Build targeted prospect lists and conduct personalized outbound outreach through approved channels.

Qualify prospects based on business fit, need, authority, timing, and budget where ascertainable.

Manage follow-ups, book discovery meetings, handle objections, prepare approved proposals, and close deals within delegated authority.

Track sales activity, proposals, opportunity outcomes, customer acquisition, and revenue through GoHighLevel.

Analyze lost opportunities and recommend improvements to outreach and conversion.



Monthly sales target: 10 new paying customers.

A completed deal means a new customer purchasing an approved eXpand AD service, recorded in GoHighLevel and verified under the company's sales process. Leads, meetings, and proposals alone do not count. Performance will be assessed in context of lead availability and quality, offer competitiveness, sales-cycle length, resources, and timely commercial approvals.



4. Reporting and Coordination

Submit one consolidated weekly report covering content output, measurable performance, CRM activity, qualified leads, meetings, pipeline progression, closed deals, revenue where available, blockers, and next steps.

Maintain accurate records and communicate issues promptly.

Follow approved client communication and campaign procedures.

Obtain approval before committing to pricing, proposals, discounts, campaigns, or other external commercial commitments.

Flag capacity constraints and deadline risks promptly.



Work Prioritization

The role is limited to 20 hours per week. Unless otherwise directed, priorities are:

Scheduled content deliverables and urgent client commitments.

Active sales opportunities, follow-ups, and meetings.

CRM accuracy, pipeline maintenance, and automation reliability.

Website support and other improvements.

The specialist must communicate competing deadlines and capacity constraints promptly.



First 14 Days

The initial 14 days focus on onboarding, understanding company services and target customers, learning brand standards, verifying system access, and establishing an actionable sales pipeline.



Expected activities:

Complete onboarding and review services, target audiences, and sales materials.

Review existing marketing assets, calendars, brand guidelines, and client requirements.

Verify access to GoHighLevel, WordPress, Canva, AI tools, and other required systems.

Establish a content production and publishing schedule.

Begin producing at least 5 complete content packages per week.

Review the sales pipeline, identify follow-up opportunities, and begin prospecting.

Verify CRM data quality and identify workflow issues.

Submit weekly progress reports.

The manager will review progress at day 14 and agree on subsequent priorities. Initial performance will account for onboarding, access, lead availability, approval turnaround, and sales-cycle length. The ongoing target of 10 new paying customers per month remains the commercial objective.



Required Qualifications

At least 2 years of marketing, growth, or related experience.

At least 2 years of direct sales experience, including prospecting, qualification, follow-up, and closing.

Practical GoHighLevel CRM and sales-pipeline experience.

Professional English suitable for client calls with US and Canadian businesses.

Working knowledge of Canva, WordPress, and AI productivity or content tools.

Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, or equivalent applications.

Ability to create content for multiple platforms and follow brand guidelines.

Strong communication, organization, and independent execution skills.

Evidence of personal contribution to previously closed sales deals.

Ability to meet the agreed schedule independently.



Languages

English: Professional fluency in written and spoken English.

Additional languages: French, Spanish, Arabic, and German are advantageous. Applicants should specify their proficiency levels.



Working Terms

Location: Remote; international applicants welcome.

Contract: Part-time freelance.

Rate: US$4/hour, up to 20 hours per week.

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM–3:00 PM US Eastern Time. Applicants must verify local working hours.

Payment: Monthly in USD for approved hours worked. Payment method, invoicing, approval process, and payment date will be specified in the freelance agreement.

Additional hours: Require prior approval.

Tools and expenses: Required company accounts and resources will be specified. No subscriptions or expenses may be incurred on behalf of the company without prior written approval.

Future opportunity: Full-time work may be considered based on performance, business needs, and budget; it is not guaranteed.



Application Requirements



Applicants must submit:

Resume or professional profile.

Short introduction describing relevant experience.

Examples of personally closed deals, including role, approximate value, and contribution.

Evidence of practical GoHighLevel experience.

Relevant marketing portfolio or work samples.

Earliest available start date.

Confirmation of acceptance of the hourly rate and schedule.

Languages spoken and proficiency levels.

Redact confidential client information. Do not submit passwords or private customer data.



Selection Process

Shortlisted candidates will participate in a structured interview covering content production, GoHighLevel, sales experience, English communication, office-suite proficiency, additional languages where relevant, availability, and evidence of previous work and personally closed deals.



Performance Management



Performance will be reviewed through regular check-ins and a weekly scorecard covering:

Content packages completed and approved.

Delivery timeliness and quality.

CRM accuracy and follow-up completion.

Prospecting and qualified opportunities.

Meetings, proposals, closed customers, and revenue where available.

Automation reliability, reporting, communication, ownership, and blocker resolution.

Targets and priorities may be reviewed as business conditions and available resources change. Material changes to working hours, compensation, or contractual obligations must be agreed through the contract process.



Confidentiality, Data Security, and Compliance

Protect company, client, prospect, and customer information. Use authorized accounts and tools, follow applicable laws and platform policies, and never disclose confidential information to unauthorized parties or upload it to unapproved AI services. Use approved claims and commercial terms only. Report suspected data incidents promptly.

Work-product ownership, confidentiality, account access, and return or deletion of company information will be governed by the freelance agreement and applicable law.



Core Competencies

Content creation; CRM and automation; sales and lead generation; B2B digital marketing; SEO/GEO; Canva, WordPress, and AI tools; Microsoft Office; analytics and reporting; communication; organization; confidentiality; and independent execution.



eXpand AD welcomes applicants of all backgrounds.

title: Podcast Video Editor — Startup & Business Content
description:
Compensation: $400 USD per month  

Workload: 4–6 podcast episodes per month and 5–8 short-form clips per week  

Position: Part-time, remote, ongoing



About the podcast:

"How Does This Get Big?" is hosted by two startup founders and content creators. We have candid conversations about building companies, growing SaaS products, marketing, entrepreneurship, and the mistakes founders make along the way.









We’re looking for a reliable editor with previous podcast-editing experience and strong business acumen. You should understand the conversations—not simply cut footage—so you can recognize valuable insights, improve the storytelling, and identify moments that will resonate with founders and entrepreneurs.



Non-negotiable requirements:

- Prior experience editing podcasts or long-form interviews

- Experience with riverside podcast platform and editing

- A portfolio containing relevant podcast work

- Strong understanding of business, startups, SaaS, marketing, or entrepreneurship

- Ability to identify valuable, clip-worthy moments without being given exact timestamps

- Strong English comprehension

- Understanding of TT/IG/YT viewer retention

- Reliable communication and consistent turnaround times



Please do not apply if you have never edited a podcast before.



Responsibilities

- Edit 4–6 complete podcast episodes each month

- Create 5–8 vertical clips each week

- Remove pauses, mistakes, repetition, and unnecessary sections.

- Switch between speakers at appropriate moments

- Improve pacing without making conversations feel unnatural

- Clean, balance, and synchronize audio

- Add captions, punch-ins, screenshots, graphics, and supporting visuals where helpful

- Format and export content for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

- Organize project files and meet agreed deadlines

- Apply feedback consistently to future episodes



We use Riverside and CapCut in-house, but you may use Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or another professional editing program.



Expected turnaround

- Full podcast episode: approximately 2–3 days

- Short-form clips: approximately 1–2 days

- Prompt communication if a deadline may be missed



This is intended to be a long-term position for the right person.



How to apply

Begin your application with the word "BIG" so we know you read the entire description.



Please include:



1. A short introduction

2. Your podcast-editing experience

3. Have you used riverside before?

4. Links to 2–3 podcast episodes you edited

5. Links to any short-form clips you created from podcasts

6. The editing software you use

7. Your typical turnaround time for a 30–60-minute podcast

8. A brief explanation of your experience with startups, SaaS, marketing, or business content



Applications without relevant podcast samples will not be considered.



Evaluation task



If selected for the next step, you will complete a brief assessment using footage we provide. It should take no more than approximately two hours.



Part 1: Podcast edit

Edit a 3–5-minute section of the podcast.



We will evaluate:

- Pacing and removal of unnecessary pauses

- Audio quality

- Use of graphics and supporting visuals

- Understanding of the business discussion

- Overall polish and attention to detail



Part 2: Short-form clip



Using the provided footage, select and edit one 30–60-second vertical clip. You will not be given the exact moment to use—we want to evaluate your ability to recognize a compelling business insight or story.



The clip should include:



- A strong opening hook

- Clean and accurate captions

- Engaging pacing

- Appropriate visual changes

- Enough context to make sense on its own

- A clear payoff

- Formatting suitable for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts



Part 3: Editorial reasoning



In 3–5 sentences, explain:



- Why you selected that moment

- Who the intended viewer is

- Why you believe the clip could perform well

- The main business insight a viewer should take away



The evaluation footage will only be used to assess applicants and will not be published or used commercially without permission.



Applicants who demonstrate strong editing ability, business understanding, good judgment, and reliable communication will be considered for the ongoing position.

title: Executive Assistant | Real Estate
description:
We are looking for a driven, detail-oriented Executive Assistant (EA) based in the Philippines to support one of our high-performing sales agents in Auckland, New Zealand.



This role is ideal for someone who genuinely enjoys organisation, takes ownership of tasks, and finds purpose in helping others perform at their very best. You will be a key part of the agent’s daily operations, working behind the scenes to keep everything running smoothly while delivering exceptional service to clients.



This is not just an admin role. It is a trusted support position where your work directly contributes to results.



---------------------------------------



About Us



Harcourts Hoverd & Co is a premium real estate company known for strong systems, high standards, and a supportive, collaborative culture. We value initiative, accountability, and people who take pride in doing things properly.



You will be working closely with an experienced agent and a wider admin, design, and operations team who believe in structure, respect boundaries, and clear communication.



---------------------------------------



Working Hours



PH Time: 4:30 AM – 1:00 PM

Monday to Friday



Applicants must be comfortable working early PH hours to align with New Zealand business operations.



---------------------------------------



Your Role



Your primary goal is to enhance agent productivity, ensure transactions flow smoothly, and help maintain an excellent client experience at every stage of the sales process.



You will act as the agent’s right hand, managing admin, listings, marketing coordination, leads, and communication so the agent can stay focused on selling.



---------------------------------------



Key Responsibilities



Administrative Support

- Manage calendar, appointments, meetings, and open homes

- Monitor and manage the agent’s
 inbox

- Flag urgent matters immediately and escalate when required

- Maintain organised digital folders and databases

- Prepare summaries and reports as requested



Listings & Marketing Support

- Assist with listing descriptions and listing covers

- Coordinate listing documents with internal teams

- Update listing statuses across platforms

- Support open home scheduling and preparation

- Coordinate marketing materials with the design team



Lead & Database Management

- Enter and track new leads accurately

- Ensure timely follow?ups and reminders

- Maintain clean, updated client and lead databases



Transaction Support

- Assist with document coordination and deadline tracking

- Support communication between clients, lawyers, and internal teams



Client Communication

- Send appointment confirmations and reminders

- Use approved templates to respond to common inquiries

- Collect and log feedback after meetings and open homes



---------------------------------------



Tools You’ll Use



Microsoft Outlook & Teams, Canva, Excel, real estate platforms, and messaging tools such as WeChat and Slack for urgent matters.



---------------------------------------



What We’re Looking For



- Strong organisational and communication skills

- High attention to detail

- Ability to work independently and follow systems

- Reliable, proactive, and professional

- Confident written and spoken English

- Prior VA or admin experience is an advantage

- Real estate experience is helpful but not required



---------------------------------------



Compensation



You are welcome to set the hourly rate you wish to receive.



Please ensure your OnlineJobs.ph profile rate is updated to reflect your current asking rate, as this is the rate we will base our offer on.



---------------------------------------



How to Apply (Important)

To be considered, applications must include BOTH:



1. Your CV

2. A short 2-minute video introducing yourself and explaining why you want this role.



Please clearly mention “Harcourts Hoverd & Co” in your video.

Applications without a video will not be considered.



---------------------------------------



Why Join Us?



- Long-term, stable role with a respected real estate brand

- Clear systems and expectations

- Supportive professional team

- Meaningful work where your contribution truly matters



If you enjoy structure, responsibility, and being the person who keeps everything running smoothly, we would love to hear from you.

title: eCommerce Virtual Assistant
description:
Our remote team is growing, and we need an eCommerce VA who is reliable, self-driven, and sharp with details, someone who wants a real career with us, not just a stopgap. We run the daily operations of online brands for clients around the world, and you’ll support several of them at once. No two days look alike. Expect busy task lists, last-minute changes, fast turnarounds, and priorities that shift quickly. We need someone who stays organized, follows our processes, handles pressure well, and keeps quality high when things get hectic.



Role details:

- Start date: as soon as possible

- Full-time, long-term

- Graveyard shift (Philippine time), Monday to Friday

- Weekends off

- Occasionally, we may ask for extra hours for urgent client requests or deadlines. It won’t be every day, but flexibility matters in our fast-paced setting.



What you’ll do:

- Run and maintain Shopify, WooCommerce, and Amazon stores

- Build, edit, and optimize product listings

- Research products, competitors, and market trends

- Help with customer support and order handling

- Keep websites updated and take care of general admin

- Support our marketing and content work

- Create simple graphics and marketing visuals in Canva

- Make basic layout and design improvements to websites

- Use ChatGPT and other AI tools to work faster and more accurately

- Follow our systems, SOPs, checklists, and instructions

- Manage tasks across multiple client accounts

- Respond quickly to updates and requests during your shift

- Keep your work organized and on time during busy periods



As you prove your reliability, we’ll give you more: greater independence with client accounts and bigger, higher-value projects.



Who we’re looking for:

- You learn fast and can figure things out on your own

- You’re highly organized with a sharp eye for detail

- You own your work and take accountability for results

- You follow instructions closely and meet deadlines

- You communicate clearly and professionally

- You’re hardworking and proactive

- You thrive in a fast-moving environment

- You stay calm and professional with urgent requests

- You have a reliable laptop or desktop and a stable, fast internet connection

- You’re fully available for the entire shift

- You have no other job, clients, business, or personal commitments that could affect your availability, focus, or performance



Bonus skills (not required):

- Shopify experience

- Canva or basic graphic design skills

- A good eye for clean layouts and visual presentation

- Experience with ChatGPT or other AI tools

- Basic video editing in CapCut

- A background in virtual assistance, eCommerce, customer service, or admin work



Experience isn’t everything. We value discipline, attitude, consistency, honesty, and reliability over years on a resume. We can teach you the technical side, but the right mindset and commitment have to come from you on day one.



Pay and growth:

- Monthly salary: ₱28,000 to ₱32,000

- Monthly performance incentive: ₱5,000 to ₱8,000

- Regular salary increases based on performance

- A clear path to promotion and bigger responsibilities

- Room to grow into senior and leadership roles

- Long-term stability for consistent top performers



Why join us:

- Build a stable, long-term career with an established eCommerce agency

- Work within clear systems and processes

- Get proper guidance, training, and regular performance feedback

- Gain hands-on skills in Shopify, Amazon, WooCommerce, and TikTok Shop

- Work with AI, automation, and modern digital tools

- Get real experience with international eCommerce brands

- Develop skills that lead to senior and leadership positions



This isn’t for everyone

We’re not looking for someone who waits to be told what to do and does only the minimum. We want someone who takes initiative, works smart, thinks critically, stays focused, and owns the outcome. The work can get intense and priorities can change fast, so you need to be comfortable adapting and handling several responsibilities at once without letting quality drop. Above all, we want someone who plans to grow with us for the long haul.



If you’re after a temporary gig, side income, an easy job, or something to do on top of another commitment, this probably isn’t the right fit.



How to apply

Please send us:



Your updated resume

A screenshot of your internet speed test

Your computer specs: device or model, processor, RAM, and storage

A short cover letter introducing yourself, sharing your relevant experience, and telling us why you’re the right person for this role



Important: Put “ECOMMERCE VA - (YOUR NAME)” in your
 subject line. Applications without it may be skipped, since it shows us you read the full post.



One last thing

This is a long-term role with real room to grow. We’re looking for someone ready to fully commit and become a reliable part of our team. You must not have other jobs, clients, or commitments that could get in the way of your schedule, availability, focus, productivity, or performance.



If you’re disciplined, driven, eager to learn, and ready to build a serious career in eCommerce, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Bookkeeper, Quarterly Reconciliation
description:
We’re a Washington State business owner with two separate, unrelated companies, including a home care agency with about $3M in annual revenue. All of our books are kept in QuickBooks Online, with each company in its own company file. We need a dependable bookkeeper to keep both sets of books accurate and current.



The role

You’ll reconcile and review the books for each company every quarter, clean up errors, and deliver accurate financials to the owner and our outside CPA. This is a part-time, recurring engagement with clear deliverables.

Responsibilities

Quarterly bookkeeping review and reconciliation in QuickBooks Online, working in two separate company files that are kept fully independent of each other

Bank, credit card, and loan account reconciliations

Review and correct transaction categorization, and clear uncategorized items

Prepare quarterly P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements for each company, with brief notes on unusual items

Reconcile payroll and sales tax liability accounts against provider reports

Prepare clean year-end files for our outside CPA

Maintain simple documentation of processes and open items



Requirements

Bachelor’s in Accountancy or related field; Philippine CPA is a plus but not required

5+ years of bookkeeping or accounting experience, including US clients

Strong knowledge of US GAAP basics

Expert-level QuickBooks Online, including experience managing multiple separate company files, plus Excel/Google Sheets

Excellent written English, high integrity, and strict confidentiality (each company’s data must be kept separate)

Reliable internet and power backup; some availability for Pacific Time calls

title: Short-Form Video Editor (Motion Graphics and Effects)
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We sell pet products across several brands on Amazon, Chewy, Shopify, TikTok Shop, Walmart, and through retail partners. We are looking for an inventive, trend-savvy short-form video editor to create scroll-stopping, high-converting video for all of our brands.



You will turn raw phone footage from our in-house team and content creators into organic TikToks and Reels, product videos for Amazon, Chewy, and TikTok Shop, and paid social and Amazon Sponsored Brands video ads.



You won’t just be cutting clips together. You will add creative flair, dynamic masking, kinetic transitions, and sound design to make simple clips feel clever and fun. You should be fluent in TikTok and IG culture, native trend formats, and creative visual editing tricks.



We work AI-first. You should already use AI features in your editing tools (for example, DaVinci Resolve Magic Mask or CapCut auto cutout) to work faster without lowering quality.



Pay: USD 1,500 to 2,000 per month, depending on experience

Schedule: 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM PST

Reports to: Creative Director. You will work day to day with our Social Media Manager and other marketing managers.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Organic Social Video (about 20 hours per week)



Edit 9:16 vertical videos for TikTok and Instagram Reels using raw footage from our in-house social team and content creators.

Apply creative visual effects, including dynamic rotoscoping and masking (sticker peel effects, freeze-frame cutouts, object pop-ins), seamless jump cuts, disappearing and appearing object tricks, match cuts, native collage, paper tear, 2D sticker animations, and seamless loops built for replay value.

Time cuts, transitions, text animations, and effects precisely to the beat of the music.

Design on-screen text with a refined eye: choose and pair fonts, set clear hierarchy and spacing, keep text within platform safe zones, and animate it so it looks polished and premium, not template-based.

Add trending audio licensed for business accounts, sound effects, animated captions, and platform-native text styles.

Bring your own ideas for hooks, pacing, and trend formats instead of only assembling footage.



Marketplace Video (about 10 hours per week)



Create product videos for Amazon (listing and A+ Content), Chewy, and other channels.

Adapt content to each platform’s formats, including 16:9, 1:1, and 9:16.

Follow each retailer’s content guidelines, with clear product benefits and demonstrations.



Paid Ads (about 15 hours per week)



Edit video ads for Meta, TikTok, and Amazon Sponsored Brands.

Produce multiple hook and format variations of each concept for testing.



AI Workflow



Use AI tools throughout your workflow to speed up turnaround, such as AI masking and rotoscoping, auto captions, beat detection, and rough cut assembly, while keeping full creative control of the final edit.

Generate and edit video and visual assets with AI tools such as Seedance, Higgsfield, and Claude, and blend them with live footage.



Across All Work



Manage a steady weekly queue of requests from the Creative Director, Social Media Manager, and marketing managers.

Keep project files organized and deliver final exports in the correct specs for each platform.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



A portfolio of TikTok and Reels edits with creative transitions, masking, and visual tricks. Talking-head videos with subtitles will not be considered.

A precise sense of rhythm. Your edits land on the beat, not near it.

Strong typography and design sense, including font pairing, hierarchy, spacing, color contrast, and adapting text style to different brand identities.



Required



Working proficiency in both CapCut and DaVinci Resolve. Our team uses both for project handoffs.

Advanced motion graphics and effects skills in at least one professional tool, such as After Effects, Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve (Fusion), or CapCut Pro.

Hands-on experience with AI video tools such as Seedance, Higgsfield, or similar.

A strong ear for sound design and audio syncing.

Deep familiarity with current TikTok and Reels trends and humor formats.

Fluent written and spoken English for daily work with a US-based team.

Ability to manage a full weekly queue and meet turnaround times.



Nice to Have



Experience creating product videos for Amazon, Chewy, or TikTok Shop.

Experience editing paid social or Amazon Sponsored Brands video ads.

Ecommerce or consumer products experience.



HOW TO APPLY



Send your application through OLJ with:



Links to 3 to 5 short-form videos you edited that show creative transitions, rotoscoping or masking tricks, or seamless loops. At least one must show beat-synced editing, and at least one must show custom on-screen typography. For each link, add one sentence naming the effect or technique you built, the software you used, and whether it shows beat-syncing or typography.

Any product, marketplace, or ad videos you have edited, if available.

Your main editing and motion graphics software, the AI tools you use, and one example of how AI shortened your turnaround on a specific video.

Your current availability and typical turnaround time per video.

Start your message with the words “ON THE BEAT” so we know you read the full post.



Make sure all links are set to public. Applications that skip any of these will not be reviewed.

title: Senior Plumbing Estimator – Australian Projects
description:
Freelance | Per Project | 100% Remote



We are looking for a highly experienced **Senior Plumbing Estimator** to join our freelance estimating network.



We're specifically looking for someone with extensive hands-on experience estimating **Australian plumbing projects**, who can independently complete detailed plumbing takeoffs, calculate accurate material quantities and prepare comprehensive supply and installation cost estimates.



You must be confident estimating complete plumbing packages, **from initial rough-in right through to final fit-off**, with minimal to no supervision.



**This is not a position for junior estimators or those still developing their plumbing estimating knowledge.** We need an experienced professional who can take a complete set of construction drawings and deliver an accurate, fully costed plumbing estimate without needing guidance through the process.



### What We're Looking For



You must have proven experience completing full plumbing takeoffs and estimates, including:



- Hot and cold water supply systems

- Sanitary plumbing, drainage and sewer systems

- Stormwater drainage and associated pipework

- Above-ground and below-ground plumbing

- Complete plumbing rough-in quantities

- Pipework lengths, sizes, fittings and connections

- Valves, pumps, backflow prevention and associated equipment

- Hot water systems and associated components

- Fixtures, fittings and final fit-off requirements

- Floor wastes, traps, inspection openings and drainage accessories

- Excavation, trenching and backfilling allowances associated with plumbing works

- Pipe insulation, supports, brackets and fixings

- Testing, commissioning and associated installation requirements

- Material quantities, wastage and installation labour allowances



You must understand how Australian plumbing systems are installed in practice, not simply how to measure quantities from drawings.



### Minimum Requirements



- Minimum 3 years' experience estimating Australian plumbing projects

- Proven experience completing full plumbing packages from rough-in through to fit-off

- Strong understanding of Australian plumbing materials, installation methods and applicable standards

- Ability to interpret architectural, hydraulic, civil and relevant engineering drawings

- Ability to independently calculate accurate material quantities, fittings and installation requirements

- **Must have your own established Australian plumbing rates library**, including material supply costs, labour rates and installation allowances. 

- Separate rates for each Australian state highly regarded

- Ability to prepare detailed, itemised Bills of Quantities and supply and installation estimates

- Experience estimating residential, commercial and/or industrial plumbing projects

- Ability to identify missing information, drawing discrepancies, assumptions and exclusions

- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy

- Strong written English and communication skills

- Reliable and able to consistently meet agreed deadlines



**Accuracy and independence are non-negotiable.**



We expect an experienced estimator who can confidently make sound estimating decisions, identify scope gaps and deliver a complete, accurate estimate without ongoing assistance or supervision.



### Costing & Rates Library



This is a critical requirement of the role.



You must already have access to your own established plumbing costing database or rates library suitable for Australian construction projects.



You should be confident applying:



- Australian plumbing material supply rates

- Labour rates and installation productivity allowances

- Pipework and fittings costs across different materials and sizes

- Fixture and equipment supply and installation costs

- Plant, equipment and associated installation allowances

- Appropriate wastage and consumable allowances

- Subcontractor and specialist plumbing costs where applicable



We are **not looking for someone who requires us to provide the rates or teach them how to price plumbing works.**



Your rates must be sufficiently current and supported by a clear pricing basis, with the ability to identify items requiring supplier quotations or project-specific confirmation.



### Software



Experience using professional takeoff and estimating software is essential.



- PlanSwift experience is highly preferred

- Experience with CostX, Bluebeam, Cubit or similar software will be considered

- Strong Excel skills for preparing detailed quantities and cost estimates

- Must have access to your own estimating software and rates library



Please include the software you have used and your level of experience with each.



### The Role



You'll be responsible for independently completing detailed plumbing takeoffs and fully costed estimates for Australian construction projects.



Responsibilities include:



- Reviewing architectural, hydraulic and relevant construction documentation

- Completing full plumbing quantity takeoffs from rough-in to fit-off

- Calculating accurate material quantities, fittings and accessories

- Preparing detailed Bills of Quantities and trade-by-trade cost breakdowns

- Applying accurate supply, labour and installation rates

- Identifying drawing discrepancies, missing information and scope gaps

- Documenting assumptions, exclusions and provisional allowances

- Producing professional, accurate and well-organised estimating reports

- Delivering completed estimates within agreed project deadlines



### Our Freelance Model



This is **not an employment position**.



Successful applicants will become part of our preferred freelance estimating network and will be offered projects based on their expertise and availability.



- Paid on a per-project basis

- No minimum workload

- No maximum workload

- Choose the projects you want to accept

- 100% remote

- Ongoing opportunities for the right estimator



### To Apply



Please include:



- How many years you've been estimating Australian plumbing projects

- Your experience completing full plumbing takeoffs and cost estimates

- Types of projects you've estimated (residential, commercial, industrial, etc.)

- Typical construction values of plumbing packages you've estimated

- Which plumbing systems you can confidently take off and cost

- **Confirmation that you have your own Australian plumbing rates library**

- How you maintain and update your material and labour pricing

- Takeoff and estimating software you've used

- Your availability and typical project turnaround times

- Your CV

- **Examples of previous complete plumbing takeoffs and fully costed estimates (required)**



**Please only apply if you are a highly experienced Australian plumbing estimator who can independently deliver complete, accurate plumbing takeoffs and fully costed estimates.**



We are looking for someone who is already operating at a senior level, is confident in their own estimating ability and can deliver professional results with little to no support.

title: E-commerce VA (Store Development & Management)
description:

Improve store navigation, user experience, and conversion performance.



Monitor store performance and recommend improvements.

Set up and manage order processing and inventory systems.



Implement workflows and automation to streamline operations.



Integrate relevant tools for marketing, analytics, inventory, and fulfillment.



Maintain accurate product and inventory information.



Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and store performance.



Qualifications



Proven experience building and managing e-commerce stores.



Hands-on experience with Shopify, WooCommerce, or other e-commerce platforms.



Ability to create and launch an online store from scratch with minimal supervision.



Experience configuring payment gateways, shipping settings, product catalogs, and integrations.

Basic knowledge of website design, store customization, and user experience.



Strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.



Excellent organizational and time-management skills.



Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects.



Nice to Have:



Basic HTML, CSS, or Liquid knowledge.



Experience with SEO and conversion rate optimization.



Familiarity with Klaviyo, Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, or similar tools.



Experience with e-commerce automation and third-party integrations.



Experience launching multiple stores or managing different e-commerce brands.



Important: Who We're Looking For



We are specifically looking for candidates with hands-on store development and technical e-commerce experience.



This position is NOT intended for applicants whose experience is limited to:



Responding to customer
s, chats, or support tickets.



Handling refunds, returns, and basic customer inquiries.



Using only basic CRM or customer contact management features.



Performing simple product uploads without understanding store setup or functionality.



Managing customer-facing tasks without experience in the backend operations of an e-commerce store.



Customer support experience is welcome, but it cannot be your primary or only e-commerce experience.



Our priority is someone who can independently build, configure, launch, troubleshoot, and manage a fully functional online store.

This is not a passive call-answering position. We’re looking for someone who is confident, personable, sales-minded, and comfortable taking ownership of every inquiry that comes their way.



You’ll often be the **first voice a potential client or family hears**, so your ability to build rapport quickly, ask the right questions, communicate value, and confidently move the conversation toward the next step is critical.



If you’re a self-starter who loves talking to people, knows how to sell without sounding scripted, and can keep up in a fast-moving environment, we want to hear from you.



## What You’ll Be Responsible For



As our **Lead Inquiry Specialist**, you’ll be responsible for answering a **very high volume of incoming calls and inquiries** from prospective clients, families, referral sources, and others interested in Home Care services.



Your goal isn’t simply to answer the phone — it’s to create an exceptional first impression, understand what the caller needs, communicate how we can help, and move qualified leads forward.



Your responsibilities will include:



• Answering a high volume of incoming calls promptly, professionally, and confidently

• Speaking with prospective clients and family members about their home care needs

• Using a consultative sales approach to build rapport, uncover needs, overcome objections, and move inquiries toward the next step

• Accurately entering, updating, and managing lead information in **Salesforce**

• Working within **WellSky** to review client information and support the inquiry and intake process

• Following up consistently with leads who are not ready to move forward immediately

• Maintaining detailed and accurate documentation of every interaction

• Prioritizing leads and recognizing which inquiries require immediate attention

• Communicating effectively with internal team members to ensure a smooth transition from inquiry to consultation and start of care

• Taking ownership of leads rather than waiting to be told what needs to happen next

• Managing multiple conversations, systems, and priorities without sacrificing accuracy or customer service



## What You Bring to the Role



• **Excellent English-speaking and communication skills are required**

• **Previous Salesforce experience is required**

• **Previous WellSky experience is required**

• Previous **sales experience is required**, preferably in phone sales, inside sales, healthcare, home care, senior care, or another service-based industry

• You are extremely comfortable spending the majority of your day on the phone

• You can confidently handle a **high volume of incoming calls** while making each caller feel heard and valued

• You are a self-starter who takes initiative and doesn’t need constant direction

• You understand how to build rapport and guide a conversation toward a decision

• You are comfortable asking questions, addressing concerns, and following up until there is a clear outcome

• You are organized, detail-oriented, and able to document information accurately while speaking with callers

• You can move quickly between Salesforce,
, and other systems

• You remain professional and composed when callers are emotional, stressed, or uncertain

• You understand that **speed, follow-up, and consistency matter in sales**

• You are dependable and take ownership of your responsibilities



## What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who sees an incoming inquiry as more than another phone call.



Every call represents a person or family looking for help — and potentially a new client for our organization. The right person understands how to balance **compassion with sales**, creating a genuine connection while confidently moving the conversation forward.



You should be competitive enough to want to convert leads, compassionate enough to understand the families calling us, and organized enough to make sure **no opportunity falls through the cracks.**



### To Be Considered



Please upload:



• Your current resume

• A brief introduction video telling us about your experience with **sales, Salesforce, and high-volume phone calls**

title: WANTED! Ambitious Head of Production & Sourcing | Custom Apparel & Promo Products
description:
*Run Your Own Department · Make an Impact at a Stable and Growing Company*

*Starts at $2,000 USD/month + Bonuses · 15 Paid Days Off*

*Full-time · Remote · Monday–Friday, 10AM-7PM Eastern Time*



WHO WE ARE

Hot Print Co makes custom apparel and promotional products for organizations across the US: colleges, companies, churches, camps, and more. We’ve been in business for more than a decade and have served thousands of organizations.



We’re a small global team with big ambitions. We don’t do layers of management or bureaucracy. We hire great people. You’ll be trusted with real responsibility, judged on results instead of hours, and paid more as your impact grows.



We’re scaling aggressively and staying lean. That means every person here matters, and every win is visible.



Check us out: 



ROLE

You own everything between an order being sold and it arriving at the customer’s door. Every order we sell is produced by a growing network of outside decorators and vendors. You work with them to make sure every order arrives correct, on time, and at the lowest possible cost.



Being responsible for every order does not mean processing orders by hand forever. That manual, routine work is being automated away so your time goes to strategic improvements.



Most of the time, when nothing is on fire, you’re finding cheaper ways to deliver the same products, and tightening our processes so mistakes don’t happen.



But sometimes, you get to jump in and be the hero! That might mean catching a problem before it costs us anything. Or rectifying a problem that already happened.



You report to our incredible Operations Manager and collaborate with her on interdepartmental decisions.



WHAT YOU OWN

- Production health: Keep every order moving. When issues surface, you solve them in real time.

- Cost and profit: For every order and expense, find money we’re leaving on the table and bring it home. Better rates, smarter sourcing, less waste. The opportunities are endless.

- The vendor network: Build a network of decorators and suppliers with the right capabilities, coverage, and pricing. Negotiate prices, set clear standards, and replace vendors as needed.

- Systems: Reduce mistakes. Automate what can be automated. Delete steps that don’t need to exist.

- Getting the order there, even when it seems impossible: A lost package. A hurricane. A critical art error. The customer still needs their order tomorrow. Most people say it can’t be done. You’re the one who finds a way.

- Being the expert everyone relies on: When the art team needs to know what a decorator can do, they come to you. When sales is quoting a product they’ve never seen, they come to you.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- You have in-depth knowledge of garments, decoration methods, and promotional products.

- You catch the smallest detail without losing sight of the big picture.

- Your written and spoken English is excellent. You’ll work directly with US vendors, including on the phone, with no hesitation.

- You use AI and technology to multiply your output. You’re the brain, not the hands.

- You have a quiet workspace with reliable power and internet.



WHAT YOU GET

- $24,000 USD per year to start, paid every two weeks through Wise.

- Annual bonus and raise.

- Extra bonuses and raises tied to the money you save us. Get a share of verified savings.

- 15 paid days off per year. And we are flexible.

- Your own department. Real decisions, real authority. No one micromanages you.

- A company that keeps its people. Our longest-serving team member has been here 7+ years.

- Room to grow. As production volume grows, your scope, your team, and your pay grow with it.

- Impact. What you do here is measurable and matters.

- You’re treated like a leader, not an assistant.



WHAT WINNING LOOKS LIKE

- Orders arrive correct and ahead of deadline.

- Production costs keep dropping without trading away quality or reliability.

- The vendor network gets broader, more competitive, and less dependent on any single vendor.

- We handle more orders without more manual work.

- Gross profit rises, and everyone can point to why.



OUR VALUES

Our mission is to build and empower a championship-level team that is proud of the work they do and how they do it. We live and die by these values. If you don’t have them, you won’t be successful here.



Championship Mindset. You prepare thoroughly, execute consistently, and hold your standard when nobody is watching. You define excellence instead of waiting to be told, and you keep raising your own bar. “Good enough” isn’t in your vocabulary.



Extreme Ownership. You own outcomes, not tasks. When something goes wrong, you ask what you could have done differently. You bring solutions, not just problems. No blame, no excuses.



Speed with Direction. You prioritize what matters most, then move fast. Act, learn, adjust. Problems get solved while they’re fresh.



Straightforward Communication. You say it clearly, early, and directly, including when it’s uncomfortable. You take feedback without taking it personally.



IS THIS RIGHT FOR YOU?

This role is not for everyone. Make sure you’re comfortable with:



- Holding vendors accountable. Calling them, pushing back, renegotiating, and sometimes dropping a vendor you like. If confrontation makes you uncomfortable, this will be hard.

- Solving problems you’ve never seen before. We don’t have playbooks for every scenario. Problems land on you, and your job is to solve them, not hand them off to someone else.

- Constant change. Our tools and processes change often because we’re automating fast.

- Being judged on numbers. We measure cost, on-time rate, and errors. Effort is great, but results are what count.

- Being a one-person department. The team scales with the work.

- Ramping up fast. The department runs smoothly today, and there’s a lot of room to make it better. Improvements start in your first week, not your sixth month.



If that list makes you excited instead of nervous, keep reading.



TO APPLY

If you are interested, please submit the following:



1. A link to your resume in PDF format named: Lastname.Firstname.Production.pdf

2. Details of your relevant experience, the results you produced, and why you would be a good fit.

3. 2-3 questions you’d want answered before taking this role.



We prefer
 submissions.

Submissions should go to: 

Use this exact subject line: "I solve problems"



We will respond to your submissions within 48 hours with next steps. Top candidates should expect an interview and paid trial task.



----------------------------------------



This function needs an exceptional owner, and we know that person is not easy to find. If that’s you — if you’ve done work like this, produced extreme results, and want this level of ownership — we want to hear from you.



If anything about the role or the instructions isn’t clear, don’t hesitate to reach out. We are happy to answer any questions!

Daily & Ongoing Coordination

 & Communication: Serve as a primary contact for transaction-related
s. Clear document requirements, proactively follow up on missing files, and chase down outstanding signatures.

Closing Updates (Weekly / Upon Closing): Closely monitor files scheduled to close in the current week. Once officially closed, update the tracking spreadsheet with the closing date and flag any lingering post-closing requirements.

Experience: 1–3+ years of experience as a Real Estate Transaction Coordinator or Compliance Specialist.



eXp Realty Familiarity: Prior experience navigating eXp Realty's compliance systems, file structures, and state-specific forms is highly preferred (nice to have).



Platform Proficiency: Advanced hands-on experience with SkySlope, standard e-signature tools, and spreadsheet management (Google Sheets / Excel).

description:
I am a growth partner for founder- and expert-led brands.  I am looking for a creative strategist who treats Meta like a lab: you come up with the ad angles, build the creative yourself, run it in meta yourself (or brief the current media buyer), and analyze the data to d
 what scales and what get tested next.



What you'll do:



- Build and test ad creative end to end: static, UGC-style, AI-generated, motion, and whatever format is working across the ads library (generally e-comm is leading indicator of trends and formats)

- Run Meta leads campaigns that send qualified traffic to landing pages optimized for conversion (or create the briefs for the current ad buyer)

- Turn results into the next round of angles, hooks, and formats



BONUS: Build content-first campaigns through branded publisher pages and listicle-style funnels, within Meta policy and healthcare advertising rules



You're a fit if:



- You can show ads you made and the conversion numbers behind them

- You know current Meta mechanics cold: Advantage+, creative diversification, account structure, testing

- You use AI tools daily to produce creative at volume without it looking like AI

- You care about cost per qualified lead, not just CTR

- You move fast and don't need a manager to tell you what to test

- You understand health/wellness ad compliance. Some of our clients are medical practices



To apply, send:



1. 3 to 5 ads you have recently created (image and video), with spend and results

2. One angle you'd test first for a cash-pay regenerative health service business

3. How you'd run a content-first funnel for a California plastic surgeon without risking the ad account



Applications missing item 3 won't be reviewed. Include your rate.

title: Meta Ads Specialist – Facebook & Instagram Advertising  Company: HSA – USA-Based Signage Manufacturing Company
description:
JOB TITLE: Meta Ads Specialist –
 & Instagram Advertising



Company: HSA – USA-Based Signage Manufacturing Company



Job Type: Ongoing Part-Time / Freelance Contract



Starting Pay: $4.00 USD per hour (reviewed after 30 days)



Work Hours: Monday–Friday, flexible schedule between 9:00 PM and 6:00 AM Philippine Time



Payment: Biweekly through Wise



ABOUT THE POSITION



HSA is looking for an experienced Meta Ads Specialist to create, manage, and optimize
 and Instagram advertising campaigns for our custom signage products targeting the USA market.



We are looking for someone who has proven experience generating e-commerce sales through paid advertising, not simply managing social media pages or creating organic content.



Our goal is to increase qualified traffic, generate conversions and sales, and improve return on advertising spend (ROAS).



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Minimum 2 years of hands-on Meta Ads experience.

- Experience managing
 and Instagram conversion campaigns.

- Strong knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Business Suite.

- Experience with Meta Pixel, conversion tracking, and retargeting.

- Knowledge of audience targeting, creative testing, and budget optimization.

- Experience advertising e-commerce products to USA customers.

- Understanding of CPC, CTR, CPA, conversions, and ROAS.

- Ability to analyze advertising performance and make data-driven improvements.

- Strong written English communication skills.

- Reliable, organized, and detail-oriented.



Meta Blueprint certification is preferred but not required.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Review and audit existing Meta advertising accounts.

- Set up, launch, manage, and optimize
 and Instagram campaigns.

- Develop advertising strategies for USA consumers and business customers.

- Research audiences, competitors, and targeting opportunities.

- Manage advertising budgets, placements, and campaign objectives.

- Create and optimize prospecting and retargeting campaigns.

- Test advertising images, videos, headlines, and ad copy.

- Coordinate with graphic designers to develop advertising creatives.

- Monitor Meta Pixel, conversion events, and tracking accuracy.

- Track advertising spend, conversions, sales, and ROAS.

- Identify underperforming advertisements and reduce wasted spending.

- Recommend improvements to product listings and landing pages.

- Provide regular campaign performance reports and recommendations.



EXPECTED WORKLOAD



- Initial setup: Up to 20 hours during the first week.

- Campaign development: Approximately 20 hours per week.

- Ongoing maintenance: Approximately 10 hours per week.



Hours are estimates, not guaranteed, and may vary based on business needs.



Candidates may choose their preferred working hours between 9:00 PM and 6:00 AM Philippine Time, Monday–Friday.



COMPENSATION & GROWTH



Starting rate is $4.00 USD per hour, with a compensation review after 30 days based on performance, reliability, and campaign results.



This is an ongoing part-time freelance contract with the potential to become a long-term or full-time position as campaigns generate sales and business needs increase.



Biweekly payment through Wise. Signed contract, NDA, and time tracking through HSA's required system are mandatory.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



1. Your resume and prior work history showing at least 2 years of relevant Meta Ads experience.

2. Any Meta Blueprint certifications you currently hold, if applicable.

3. Examples of
 and Instagram advertising campaigns you personally managed, including budgets, conversions, sales, and ROAS.

4. At least two professional references with contact information.

5. The advertising, analytics, and reporting tools you use.

6. Your preferred working hours between 9:00 PM and 6:00 AM Manila Time, Monday–Friday.

7. Confirmation that you accept the $4.00 USD starting hourly rate and contract requirements.

8. A 3-minute Loom video introducing yourself, describing your Meta Ads experience, and explaining why you are a strong fit for this position.

title: HIRING Senior Direct Response Video Editor | VSLs, AI Ads & E-Commerce (US Pet Supplement Brand)
description:
# Senior Direct Response Video Editor | VSLs, AI Ads & E-Commerce



**WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR BEGINNERS.**



We are looking for a highly experienced **Direct Response Video Editor & AI Creative Specialist** to join our growing pet supplement e-commerce brand targeting the US market.



This is NOT a basic video editing position.



We need someone who understands **direct response marketing, consumer psychology, visual storytelling, and what actually makes people stop scrolling, keep watching, and ultimately buy.**



You should already have extensive experience creating high-converting VSLs, AI-generated video ads, UGC-style creatives, and long-form direct response advertisements.



We are not looking for someone who just follows instructions and puts clips together. We need an editor who understands WHY certain visuals work and how to turn a strong script into a compelling, conversion-focused video.



## WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



- Editing high-converting Video Sales Letters (VSLs), both short-form and long-form.

- Creating AI-generated video ads using tools such as Kling, Veo, Runway, HeyGen, or similar platforms.

- Turning direct response scripts into visually engaging advertisements.

- Developing powerful visual hooks that immediately grab attention within the first 1–3 seconds.

- Using strategic B-roll, AI-generated scenes, animations, captions, sound effects, and pacing to maintain viewer attention.

- Matching visuals precisely to the emotional and psychological intent of each script.

- Creating authentic-looking UGC-style ads, advertorial-style creatives, and native social media advertisements.

- Editing Meta 
/Instagram) video ads optimized for conversions.

- Creating multiple variations of hooks, angles, and video creatives for testing.

- Improving existing ads based on performance data and feedback.

- Producing content for an English-speaking US audience.



## WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU



**1. Strong Direct Response Understanding**



You must understand how direct response advertising works.



You should know how to visually communicate pain points, emotional triggers, curiosity, mechanisms, benefits, proof, objections, and offers.



Every scene should serve a purpose.



**2. Exceptional Hook Execution**



A strong script is useless if the visuals don't grab attention.



You must know how to transform written hooks into powerful visual hooks that make viewers stop scrolling.



You understand concepts such as pattern interrupts, curiosity gaps, open loops, and visual attention retention.



**3. VSL & Storytelling Experience**



You understand how to keep people engaged throughout a video.



This includes knowing when to change scenes, introduce B-roll, emphasize certain words, build emotional tension, present proof, and transition into the product pitch.



**4. Advanced AI Video Skills**



You have practical experience generating realistic, high-quality AI video footage and integrating it naturally into advertisements.



Your work should feel authentic, not like generic AI-generated content.



**5. Performance-Driven Editing**



You understand metrics such as Hook Rate, Hold Rate, CTR, CPA, and ROAS.



You know that a visually beautiful video isn't necessarily a profitable advertisement.



Your goal is to create videos that SELL.



**6. High Editing Standards**



- Professional pacing and visual storytelling

- Strong sound design

- Clean, readable subtitles

- Seamless scene transitions

- High-quality AI and stock footage selection

- Native-looking social media creatives

- Strong attention to detail

- Ability to work independently and meet deadlines



## REQUIREMENTS



- Proven experience editing Direct Response VSLs and paid social media advertisements.

- A strong portfolio featuring real e-commerce advertisements.

- Previous experience with AI-generated video creatives.

- Excellent understanding of the US e-commerce market and its advertising style.

- Ability to understand English scripts and produce fully English-language advertisements.

- Experience with professional editing software such as Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut.

- Ability to interpret creative briefs and scripts without needing detailed instructions for every scene.

- Ability to receive feedback, iterate quickly, and consistently deliver high-quality work.

- Understanding of platform advertising policies and the importance of using substantiated claims and authentic testimonials.



**BONUS POINTS:**



- You have completed or studied the EcomTalent course.

- You have worked with US supplement brands.

- You have experience in the pet, health, wellness, or nutraceutical niches.

- You have previously edited winning ads with proven performance.

- You understand copywriting frameworks, awareness levels, and direct response marketing psychology.

- You have experience working with media buyers or creative strategists.



## WHO THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR



- Beginners who are just learning video editing.

- Editors who only make aesthetic videos without understanding conversions.

- People who rely entirely on generic stock footage.

- Editors who cannot translate scripts into compelling visual stories.

- People who need step-by-step guidance for every creative decision.

- Anyone without relevant Direct Response or VSL experience.



## WHAT WE OFFER



- Opportunity to work with a growing US-focused e-commerce brand.

- Consistent work and potential for a long-term collaboration.

- Clear scripts, creative briefs, and performance feedback.

- Opportunities to experiment with AI tools and advanced creative strategies.

- Competitive compensation based on experience and quality.

- Potential to take on more responsibility as the brand scales.



We value **skill, creativity, reliability, and performance** over certificates or years of experience alone.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



1. Your portfolio with at least 3–5 relevant Direct Response video ads or VSLs.

2. Examples of AI-generated video advertisements you have personally created. ( WE WILL CHECK EVERYTHING IN CALL PLEASE UPLOAD ONLY YOUR CONTENT!)

3. Your experience working with e-commerce or supplement brands.

4. Any performance results from your creatives, if available.

5. The AI video generation and editing tools you regularly use.

6. Your pricing structure, availability, and typical turnaround time.



**Applications without relevant examples of Direct Response editing will not be considered.**



We are looking for someone who can genuinely contribute to the growth of the brand, not just complete editing tasks.



**IMPORTANT:** To confirm that you have read the entire job description, start your application with the number **67** before writing anything else. Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be considered.

title: Bookkeeper, Accounting and Payroll (Work From Home), full-time
description:
Content Rewards pays creators for short clips they post for brand campaigns. We are a small US company (Content Rewards Inc.) with a remote team of about 40 people across many countries, hundreds of vendors and a lot of money moving every month. We are hiring one careful, organised bookkeeper to own the books, the monthly payroll run and the paperwork around them.



ROLE DETAILS

• Full-time, 40 hours a week, long-term.

• Pay: $10–$14 USD an hour, depending on experience. Paid monthly.

• Work hours are flexible, but you must overlap at least 4 hours a day with 09:00–18:00 Dubai time (UTC+4), and be reachable on payroll days (the 15th and the last working day of the month).

• You report directly to the COO, who approves every payment. Questions go to one person, and you get written answers you can work from.

• Shortlisted candidates do a short paid trial task, then the hire starts with a paid two-week trial period at the agreed hourly rate before the long-term offer.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Keep the books in QuickBooks Online: categorise every bank and card transaction, match receipts and invoices, and reconcile Mercury (our bank), PayPal, Wise and Whop every month.

• Run payroll: prepare the monthly and twice-monthly pay list for about 40 contractors and employees in many countries, check amounts against contracts, get sign-off, and prepare the transfers in Mercury and Gusto for the COO to approve.

• Accounts payable: collect vendor invoices, check them against what was agreed, schedule payments, and chase missing receipts so nothing is paid twice or without paperwork.

• Accounts receivable: send client invoices, track what is paid and overdue, and follow up politely with clients until the money arrives.

• Compliance paperwork: collect W-9 and W-8 forms from everyone we pay, keep them filed, and prepare the yearly 1099 list for our accountants.

• Month-end close: a clean P&L and balance sheet, a short note on anything unusual, and cash on hand versus upcoming bills.

• Keep the expense and travel receipt sheets up to date and tidy.

• Work with our outside accountants on the yearly tax return and answer their document requests.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• At least 2 years of bookkeeping or accounting work for a US company, including real month-end closes you did yourself.

• Confident in QuickBooks Online. Experience with Gusto, Mercury, Wise or PayPal is a plus.

• You have run payroll for a team before, including contractors in several countries.

• Very careful with numbers and names: you check twice, you never pay from memory, and you keep a paper trail for everything.

• Discreet. You will see salaries, bank balances and personal details, and they stay with you.

• Clear written English. You can explain a number in one short sentence.

• Comfortable with Google Sheets and with following a written process.

• A reliable computer and internet connection, and a quiet place to work.

• Philippine CPA (or an equivalent accounting qualification) preferred. Showing us clean work matters just as much.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Reply here on OnlineJobs with your CV and answers to these four questions, in writing:

• Which companies have you kept books for, in which tool, and what did a normal month-end look like for you?

• Describe one time you caught a payment mistake before it went out. What did you check, and what did you do?

• A contractor says they were paid $200 short. Walk us through exactly what you would check, in order, before replying to them.

• What hours can you work, what is your time zone, when could you start, and what is your expected hourly rate in USD?



2. Record a separate 3–5 minute spoken Loom introducing yourself and talking us through your answer to the $200 question. Webcam is optional. Check that we can open the Loom without requesting access, or share it with 
 the answers yourself. Do not use ChatGPT or other AI tools: we want to see how you think. We read every application, and shortlisted candidates get a short paid trial task with real-looking (but fictional) transactions.

title: Part-Time Junior Creative Strategist

- Love social media and keep up with trends

- Have a good eye for engaging, scroll-stopping content

- Enjoy researching competitors and finding creative inspiration

- Are organized, detail-oriented, and reliable

- Can work independently and meet deadlines

- Communicate clearly and are comfortable using Google Drive and Sheets (
 is a plus!)

- Previous experience in social media or marketing is a plus, but not required. We’re happy to work with someone eager to learn and grow!

We’re excited to meet someone creative and curious who wants to grow with our team.

title: Healthcare Insurance Verifications Specialist
description:
PLEASE INCLUDE A LINK TO YOUR RESUME IN YOUR MESSAGE. APPLICANTS WHO DO NOT INCLUDE A LINK IN YOUR MESSAGE WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



Position Overview:

An Insurance Verifications Specialist is responsible for ensuring the accuracy and completeness of healthcare insurance information for patients or clients. This role involves verifying insurance coverage, confirming if prior authorizations are needed or not, and working closely with insurance companies.



Pocket Overview:

Pocket provides a cheaper and faster insurance verification process for physical therapists.

We know that insurance verification is painful and can take up to 1-2 hours to verify a patient's insurance coverage, potentially delaying appointment scheduling and care.

Pocket will take on the pain of dealing with insurance so front desk staff can focus on customer-facing interactions and PTs can focus on what they do best – treating patients.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Healthcare Insurance Verification:

Confirm patient eligibility and insurance coverage by contacting insurance carriers via phone.

Responsible for effective and efficient verification of all patients’ benefits before their appointment.

Verify benefits for physical therapy services.

Ensure accurate documentation of coverage details, including co-pays, deductibles, out-of-pocket expenses, authorization requirements and visit limits.

2. Authorizations:

Confirm if authorization is needed or not

If it’s needed, confirm what is required to submit authorization

3. Data Entry and Record Maintenance:

Accurately input insurance details into our internal database or client’s EMR platform.

Update patient accounts with the latest insurance information and maintain confidentiality in compliance with HIPAA regulations.

Record calls using online recording software (provided by Pocket)

4. Customer and Team Support:

Serve as a point of contact for physical therapy admin staff with questions about their insurance coverage or billing.

5. Problem-Solving:

Identify and address insurance coverage issues or errors proactively.

Follow up with insurance companies if there is conflicting information.



Qualifications and Skills:

1. Experience:

2+ years of experience in insurance verification, medical billing, or a related field.

Familiarity with U.S. based insurance plans, benefits, and medical terminology.



2. Technical Skills:

Proficiency in using EMR systems, insurance portals, Google Suite (Google Docs, Google Sheets) and Microsoft Office Suite.

Strong data entry skills with high attention to detail.

3. Interpersonal Skills:

Excellent written / verbal communication and customer service skills.

Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.

4. Problem-Solving: Analytical skills to resolve coverage discrepancies

5. Security:

Must adhere to all HIPAA guidelines and regulations.

Maintain patient and company confidentiality.



Work Environment:

Remote

Must be able to work weekdays 9am - 5pm Eastern Time Zone

Must have reliable internet connection and use their personal computer

Requires heavy interaction with insurers via phone



This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in a detail-oriented, fast-paced environment and have a passion for supporting healthcare processes.



Interview Process:

1) Short Case Study

2) Testing

3) Behavioral Interview
