title: Real Estate Virtual Assistant | Follow Up Boss & RealScout
description:
Francia Team | eXp Realty

Full-time remote position | 40 hours per week | Pacific Time working hours

Compensation: $800-$1,200 per month, based on experience.



We're looking for a dependable real estate virtual assistant who knows Follow Up Boss, is comfortable with technology, and follows through without constant reminders.



Your main focus will be Follow Up Boss, RealScout, client follow-up, and scheduling. You'll work closely with our administrative assistant and team leadership to keep communication, appointments, and systems organized.



We'll train you on our processes. We expect you to take notes, use checklists, ask thoughtful questions, and apply feedback.



YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES



Follow Up Boss and client follow-up

- Monitor team texts, calls, missed calls, and client activity. Flag urgent items and track unanswered inquiries through resolution.

- Maintain accurate contact information, tags, notes, follow-up tasks, and deal stages using verified information.

- Summarize client calls and make sure each follow-up has an owner and a deadline.



RealScout and inquiry monitoring

- Set up and maintain property searches based on documented client preferences.

- Check listing results manually and refine filters when needed.

- Monitor client messages and engagement, and flag opportunities for follow-up.

- Monitor Zillow inquiries and alert the team when something needs to be claimed, answered, or updated.



Scheduling and showing coordination

- Coordinate buyer consultations, listing appointments, showings, inspections, photography, and video shoots.

- Check availability, place calendar holds, confirm seller approval, and send invitations and reminders.

- Track showing feedback and keep everyone informed when plans change.



SUPPORTING ADMINISTRATIVE DUTIES

- Prepare clear
s and texts using our templates and approval process.

- Keep transaction chats, calendars, files, and production tracking records organized.

- Request documents and updates from escrow, lenders, and vendors as directed.

- Provide limited document organization and SkySlope filing support under team supervision. Contract preparation, interpretation, and negotiation remain with licensed team members.

- Track upcoming deadlines, listing preparation, key coordination, and client review reminders.

- Document repeatable tasks in clear procedures and maintain checklists.



WHAT YOU NEED

- Hands-on Follow Up Boss experience. Be ready to explain what you have personally managed in the platform.

- RealScout experience strongly preferred, including search setup and refinement.

- Experience supporting a U.S. real estate team.

- Strong Google Workspace skills and clear written and spoken English.

- Careful attention to names, recipients, addresses, dates, and attachments.

- Consistent availability during agreed Pacific Time working hours, including changes for U.S. daylight saving time.

- Proactive updates, early communication about blockers, and ownership of completing your work accurately.



REQUIRED WORK SETUP

- A Mac computer with two working screens. A MacBook plus an external monitor is acceptable.

- An iPhone for our team's communication workflow.

- Reliable high-speed internet and a practical backup plan for internet or power interruptions.

- A quiet workspace, webcam, and headset.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:

1. Your resume and a brief description of your U.S. real estate support experience.

2. Specific examples of your Follow Up Boss and RealScout experience.

3. Your expected monthly rate, Pacific Time availability, and earliest start date.

4. Your Mac model and confirmation that you have an iPhone and two working screens.

5. A short video made specifically for this role explaining your relevant experience and how you keep client follow-up and appointments from falling through the cracks.



Selected applicants will complete a short practical exercise using sample information. Please do not share private client information or passwords.



Success in this role means the team can hand you a task, know where it stands, and trust that it will be completed accurately.

title: Bilingual (Spanish/English) Orthodontic Patient Engagement & Scheduling Coordinator | Full Time | $7 to $9/hr
description:
Location: Remote, Philippines based candidates only

Schedule: Full Time, 40 hours/week, Long Term

Work Hours: Pacific Time business hours, 8:00am to 5:00pm PT (overnight in the Philippines, about 11:00pm to 8:00am; shifts one hour in November when U.S. daylight saving ends)

Compensation: $7 to $9 USD/hour based on experience

Please confirm you can work this overnight Philippine schedule before applying.



About the Role

We are hiring a Bilingual Patient Engagement & Scheduling Coordinator to support orthodontic practices in Northern California. You will start with one practice and expand to a second, so you will manage scheduling and patient communication for more than one office.



You will be the friendly, reliable voice patients and parents hear when they call, text, or
. You will keep the schedule full and organized, follow up with patients who cancel or miss appointments, and make sure Spanish-speaking families feel just as informed and welcome as English-speaking ones.

This is a patient-facing role with live phone calls, not a back-office-only role.



Must Haves (Non-Negotiable)

If you cannot check every box below, please do not apply.

1. You are fluent in spoken and written Spanish and English and can hold a full, natural phone conversation with a patient or      parent in either language.

2. You have 1+ year of experience scheduling patients or coordinating patient communication in an orthodontic, dental, or other healthcare setting.

3. You have used a dental or orthodontic practice management or scheduling system to book, move, and confirm appointments (Ortho2 Edge, Open Dental, Dentrix, Curve, or similar).

4. You are warm, clear, and confident on the phone with U.S. patients.

5. You understand patient privacy and are comfortable working in a HIPAA-regulated environment.

6. You can work 8:00am to 5:00pm Pacific Time and have reliable internet, a backup connection or power plan, and a quiet workspace for calls.



Nice to Haves

1. Orthodontic office experience (braces, aligners, retainers, treatment-in-progress scheduling)

2. Hands-on experience with Ortho2 Edge

3. Experience with patient texting or communication platforms

4. A track record of reducing no-shows or filling open schedule slots

5. Experience supporting more than one office or location



What You’ll Do



1. Scheduling

    Book, reschedule, and confirm patient appointments across the practice calendar

    Keep provider schedules full and well organized

    Handle cancellations and last-minute changes and fill open slots when possible

    Schedule new patient consultations from inbound calls, texts, and web inquiries



2. Patient Engagement

    Send appointment reminders and confirmations by phone, text, and

    Follow up with patients who cancel, no-show, or fall behind on treatment visits

    Reach out to patients who are overdue for appointments and help them get back on schedule

    Respond to patient and parent questions quickly, warmly, and accurately



3. Bilingual Support

    Communicate fluently with Spanish-speaking patients and parents by phone, text, and

    Explain appointment details, what to expect at a visit, and next steps clearly in either language



4. Coordination & Documentation

title: Senior SDR / B2B Cold Calling & Appointment Setting – US Technology Company

**Full-Time | Remote (Philippines) | US Eastern Business Hours**

### About the Position



We are an established US-based Managed IT Services and Cybersecurity company seeking an experienced Sales Development Representative (SDR) to build and execute our outbound prospecting program.



**We are NOT looking for a beginner or someone who requires constant supervision.**



We want an experienced, self-motivated sales professional who knows how to find prospects, make cold calls, engage business decision-makers, and consistently schedule qualified appointments.



**This is a hands-on position. You will personally make outbound cold calls every day.**

- Make daily outbound cold calls to US business owners and decision-makers.

- Identify prospective customers, build targeted calling lists, and research contacts.

- Qualify opportunities and schedule appointments with genuinely interested prospects.

- Recommend and help implement prospecting tools such as Apollo, ZoomInfo, or similar platforms.

This is a fully remote role for international candidates. You must have a reliable high-speed internet connection, a backup power supply, and a dedicated workspace.



Overview

Ballard House is a founder-led ecommerce company that partners with established brands to scale Amazon operations using our in-house logistics, content creation and advertising infrastructure. Founded in 2017, we began as an Amazon reseller and evolved into our current brand partnership model in 2023, bringing operational excellence to a select portfolio of eight and nine-figure brands. 



We are hiring a Catalog Specialist to support our catalog and brand management operations. Working alongside the Catalog Lead, you will be responsible for executing the fundamental backend tasks that keep our Amazon listings accurate, organized, and running smoothly. This includes routine database maintenance, Seller Central updates, basic report pulling, variation setups, flat-file uploads, and drafting and editing listing copy. 



This is an entry-level execution role with high growth potential. In a flat team like ours, accuracy and speed speak louder than org charts. Bring solid work ethics, high attention to detail, and a desire to learn, and you’ll grow quickly alongside our team.

Maintain clean and accurate spreadsheets, databases, and catalog documentation.

Follow established SOPs and processes for routine catalog operations.

Assist with basic catalog audits and quality checks to ensure listings and data remain accurate.

Monitor and appropriately respond to Account Health notifications and Customer Messages.

Communicate questions, issues, and completed work clearly with the Catalog Lead and broader team.

Learn and gradually take on more advanced Amazon catalog tasks as your skills develop.





Qualifications



Entry-level role: No prior e-commerce or Amazon experience required (a willingness to learn quickly and follow established processes is essential).

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

High attention to detail with strong organizational instincts—you naturally double-check your work before submitting it.

Comfortable working with basic spreadsheets, Google Sheets, or Microsoft Excel.

Comfortable performing repetitive data entry and administrative tasks while maintaining accuracy.

Able to follow written instructions and established SOPs consistently.

Fast learner who takes feedback and direction well.

Reliable, organized, and able to manage multiple simple tasks without losing track of details.

Strong work ethic and a willingness to ask questions when something is unclear.

Basic computer proficiency and comfort learning new software and online platforms.





This role is for you if:



You take pride in high accuracy and double-checking details.

You enjoy organizing information and keeping spreadsheets and databases tidy.

You are comfortable following established processes while learning how things work.

You learn quickly, ask questions when stuck, and take feedback positively.

You can work independently once you've been trained on a task.

You want to develop real-world skills in Amazon and e-commerce operations.

You want a stable, full-time remote career with a growing e-commerce company.

You are motivated by the opportunity to grow into more advanced catalog, e-commerce, or operations roles.





Probably not the right fit if you:



Dislike repetitive data entry or detail-oriented tasks.

Have difficulty following established processes or written instructions.

Frequently rush through tasks without checking for errors.

Are looking for a role that is primarily strategic rather than execution-focused.

Dislike digging through complex flat files or opening Seller Support tickets to resolve glitches.

Prefer shipping a project once without continually auditing or improving it.

Feel like giving or receiving process feedback is uncomfortable.



Benefits

We invest in people who move the business forward. We offer competitive compensation and a high-trust, high-performance environment where operators can thrive. Perks include:



Paid time off and paid holidays

100% remote work flexibility

Direct access to company leadership and opportunity to learn Amazon e-commerce ops from scratch

Upward mobility into senior specialist or lead roles based on performance



Company Core Values



These aren’t poster values. We use them every day to make decisions. If they match how you operate, you’ll fit right in.





Unimpeachable Character: Be someone others are always proud to associate with, personally and professionally



Open and Honest: Feedback is our fuel to grow



Play to Win: Define what it takes to win, then do it



Always Moving Forward: We choose relentless positivity









How to Apply:





Please submit a 1-3 minute video answering the following. We don't care about polish--care about clarity, energy, and how you think.



1. Why are you interested in this position?

2. What are your strengths?

3. What's something small you've learned recently that made a real difference?





Submit your video via this Google Form:

-Develop and execute creative marketing strategies for LinkedIn,
, Instagram, and X.

-Create engaging content, campaigns, Reels, and industry-focused storytelling.

-Build brand visibility and engagement among US shippers, freight brokers, and logistics professionals.

-Track performance and continuously optimize content strategies.



Google Ads & Lead Generation

-Plan, launch, and manage Google Ads campaigns, particularly Search campaigns.

-Conduct keyword research, audience targeting, competitor analysis, and conversion tracking.

-Optimize campaigns to improve click-through rates, cost per lead, and return on ad spend.

-Generate qualified B2B leads, not just clicks and impressions.

-Manage advertising budgets efficiently and report measurable campaign results.



Press Releases & Public Relations

-Research and identify newsworthy freight and logistics topics.

-Write professional, compelling, SEO-conscious press releases aligned with industry news and company developments.

-Prepare press releases for distribution through platforms such as EIN Presswire.

-Ensure content meets editorial standards, factual accuracy, and publication requirements.

-Support brand credibility, media exposure, and public relations initiatives.



Marketing Performance & Growth

-Develop strategies that connect social media, paid advertising, PR, and business development.

-Monitor KPIs, website traffic, conversions, campaign performance, and lead generation.

-Present actionable recommendations and monthly performance reports.

-Proactively identify opportunities to improve our market presence.



WHAT YOU MUST BRING:



-Minimum 3 years of proven experience in digital marketing, social media strategy, or B2B marketing.

-Previous experience in freight, transportation, or logistics is REQUIRED.

-Demonstrated proficiency in Google Ads, including campaign setup, optimization, and conversion tracking.

-Proven experience in press release writing, editing, and distribution.

-Strong knowledge of SEO, Google Analytics, and digital marketing performance metrics.

-Experience with LinkedIn, Meta Business Suite, Canva, and marketing automation tools.

-Excellent English writing, research, and storytelling skills.

-Ability to work independently, think creatively, and deliver results without constant supervision.



DON'T TELL US YOU'RE A GREAT MARKETER. SHOW US.



We want to see actual achievements from your previous employers or clients.



Tell us:

-Social Media: How much did you grow engagement, reach, or followers? What business results followed?

-Google Ads: What budgets have you managed? What were your conversion rates, cost per lead, and campaign results?

-Press Releases: How many have you written or published? Which distribution platforms have you used? Share published links.

-Lead Generation: How many qualified leads or business inquiries did your marketing campaigns generate?

-Overall Impact: What's your biggest marketing achievement, and how did you measure its success?



Real numbers. Real campaigns. Real results.



YOUR FIRST CHALLENGE



Along with your application, briefly answer:



"If you had 90 days to increase a freight brokerage company's visibility and generate more qualified US shipper inquiries using social media, Google Ads, and press releases, what would be your first three priorities?"



We want to see how you think, not just what tools you know.



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:

-Updated resume and marketing portfolio.

-Links to social media accounts or campaigns you've managed.

-Google Ads performance examples, including measurable results.

-At least 2 published press releases you've written.

-Your top 3 measurable marketing achievements.

-Your expected hourly rate in USD.



Application Subject: I MAKE MARKETING WORK - [Your Name]



IMPORTANT:



This is NOT an entry-level position.



If your experience is limited to posting graphics, writing captions, or boosting posts, this role is not the right fit.



We're looking for someone who understands the bigger picture: strategy, execution, measurable growth, and business results.



If you've done it before, show us what you've accomplished.

title: Video Creator/Editor - Product Videos
description:
Location: Remote 

Job Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented Video Editor to join our team and help produce short, engaging product videos for our portfolio of consumer brands.

In this role, you will primarily work with existing product photography and still images, transforming them into professional, engaging short-form videos using animations, transitions, text overlays, music, and other editing techniques.

You will not be expected to film products or capture original footage. Instead, your focus will be on bringing static product images to life through creative video editing.

The ideal candidate has a good eye for design, experience with video editing software, and the ability to produce quality content efficiently. Experience with AI-powered creative tools is a plus.

Key Responsibilities

Video Creation & Editing

Transform sets of product photos and still images into engaging short-form videos, typically 10–30 seconds long.

Add smooth animations, pan and zoom effects, transitions, motion graphics, and text overlays to create visually appealing videos.

Incorporate background music, sound effects, and other elements when appropriate.

Create videos that effectively showcase product features, benefits, and uses.

Produce videos in different sizes and aspect ratios based on project requirements.

Edit and revise videos based on feedback to ensure a polished final product.

Creative Development

Use creativity to make static product images feel dynamic and engaging.

Develop reusable video templates and editing styles to improve production efficiency.

Maintain consistent visual quality across different brands and product categories.

Ensure products are represented accurately and professionally in all videos.

AI-Assisted Video Creation

Explore and use AI-powered tools to assist with video editing, image animation, and content creation.

Use AI tools to enhance existing images or create realistic backgrounds and visual elements when appropriate.

Maintain product accuracy and visual quality when working with AI-generated content.

Organization & Workflow

Manage multiple video projects and meet assigned deadlines.

Maintain organized project files, source images, and completed videos.

Work independently while communicating progress and incorporating feedback from the team.

Required Qualifications

Previous experience in video editing or video content creation.

Proficiency with at least one video editing program, such as Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar software.

Ability to create engaging videos from still images using animations, transitions, and effects.

Good understanding of visual composition, pacing, typography, and video presentation.

Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality work.

Ability to manage multiple projects and work independently in a remote environment.

Good written and verbal English communication skills.

A portfolio or examples of previous video editing work.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience creating product videos, promotional videos, or short-form social media content.

Experience with Adobe After Effects or basic motion graphics.

Familiarity with AI-powered image and video creation tools.

Experience creating videos for e-commerce products or online stores.

Experience working with reusable video templates and high-volume content production.

What You'll Be Working On

Our company manages a large portfolio of consumer products across categories such as home, furniture, outdoor recreation, tools, toys, and kitchen accessories.

You will receive sets of existing product images and supporting product information, then turn those assets into short, polished videos that bring the products to life.

No filming, photography, or paid advertising experience is required.

Our main priorities are creativity, video editing ability, attention to detail, and the ability to produce professional content efficiently.

title: Part-Time Customer Experience Associate - Graveyard Shift
description:
Role: Part-Time Customer Experience Associate - Graveyard Shift

Location: Remote

Hours: Approx. 20 hrs/week (graveyard / night shift, weekends required)

Start Date: ASAP 



CALILY Bridal is an American-Australian accessible-luxury brand offering wedding veils and bridal accessories, with most of our customers in the USA. Our team is growing and we’re looking for another warm, thoughtful, and detail-oriented Customer Experience Associate to join us part-time.



About the Shift - Please Read Carefully:

This is a graveyard shift role. These are not flexible hours - they are the specific times when our customers are most active across our inbox, live chats and DMs, and our current team is not rostered on.



You must be able to work all of the following shifts, in Philippines time, on an ongoing basis:

- Tuesday: 3am–7am

- Wednesday: 11pm–2am

- Thursday: 11pm–2am 

- Saturday: 7pm–10pm

- Sunday: 9pm–4am



Most of these shifts are overnight / early morning in the Philippines because they cover US daytime and evening peaks.

Please only apply if you are genuinely happy to work these graveyard hours consistently - this is the core requirement of the role.



About the Role

As the voice of CALILY Bridal, you’ll be responding to brides through Commslayer, our main platform for
, live chat, and Instagram & TikTok DMs/comments. You will help them choose their dream veil, update them on their orders, initiate returns and exchanges, and make sure every single message feels personal, supportive, and genuine.



This is not your typical customer service gig, we’re looking for someone who loves love stories, understands the high emotions behind a wedding purchase, and can bring a deeply human touch to every message (all while being highly efficient and detail-oriented!).



What You’ll Do...

- Communicate with Care: Provide warm, timely, and thoughtful responses to customer enquiries via Commslayer —
, live chat, Instagram & TikTok DMs/comments.

- Track Every Detail: Maintain impeccable accuracy when updating customer records, processing orders, and noting specific bridal requests so nothing falls through the cracks. Keep returns data and custom orders data accurately updated in 
 (familiarity with 
 is a plus).

- Offer Styling Advice: Guide brides on veil styles, lengths, colors, timelines, and compatibility with their dresses.

- Manage Orders: Handle order updates, initiate returns and exchanges in Shopify, and manage custom requests with clarity and calm.

- Be the Brand: Maintain our warm and professional brand tone, following CALILY Bridal’s tone of voice guidelines.

- Problem Solve: Escalate product or shipping issues when needed, while taking full ownership of the customer relationship.

- Assist with Content: Occasionally support the team by writing FAQ responses or updating product content.



You’ll Be a Great Fit If You…

- Have your own laptop and reliable internet, and can consistently work all the graveyard shifts listed above, including weekends.

- Are heavily detail-oriented: You triple-check shipping dates and wedding dates, catch tiny discrepancies in orders, and naturally remember the small personal details brides share with you.

- Are a master communicator: You have excellent written English, ensuring every message is clear, perfectly professional, and easy to understand.

- Lead with deep empathy: You genuinely care about the brides you help, staying calm under pressure and handling last-minute bride panics with absolute grace.

- Ideally have familiarity with Commslayer, or have used similar customer service tools like Manychat, Gorgias, Zendesk, or similar platforms, and can learn Commslayer quickly.

- Have some familiarity with 
 for tracking returns and custom orders.

- Are fluent in Shopify, for order lookups, updates, and initiating returns/exchanges.

- Have experience in bridal, weddings, or women’s fashion (bonus points if you’ve worked with brides directly).

- Understand how to turn challenging conversations into loyal, long-term customer relationships.

- Work independently, but know exactly when to ask questions or flag issues.



How to Apply:

Applications that do not follow all of the steps below will not be considered.



- At the very top of your application, please write: “I love cats” - this is our way of knowing you read the full job post.



- A small task - please complete this styling reply:

A bride is wearing an A-line dress with a sweetheart neckline, her wedding is in 3 weeks, and she’s torn between a fingertip-length and a cathedral-length veil. Write the reply you would send her, including what you would ask her, and what you would recommend.



- Confirmation that you can start ASAP and work all of the shifts listed above in Philippines time (Tue 3–6am, Wed 11pm–2am, Thu 11pm–2am, Sat 7–10pm, Sun 9pm–4am) 



We can’t wait to meet someone who shares our passion for heartfelt customer experiences and helping brides feel calm and confident before their big day!

title: Operations Manager
description:
# Operations Manager



**Philippines · Fully Remote · Full-Time · U.S. Working Hours**



A U.S. construction business is expanding into commercial projects and needs a resourceful Operations Manager to help build the team, establish processes, and coordinate the work behind that expansion.



You will partner closely with the owner on a varied mix of hiring, contractor outreach, technology research, supplier coordination, and management support. Expect to investigate unfamiliar subjects, organize incomplete information, and take assignments from an initial idea through to completion.



We welcome applicants whose achievements demonstrate strong reasoning and initiative, even if their previous job titles do not match this position.



## Your Responsibilities



**Build and maintain hiring pipelines**



Identify professionals who could strengthen the commercial team, including construction project managers and estimators in the United States, along with an experienced remote estimator in Latin America.



Your work will involve researching potential hires, contacting people who may not be actively looking, presenting the opportunity, arranging interviews, and keeping candidate information current. Continue developing these relationships as the team grows so future vacancies can be addressed promptly.



**Develop connections with potential customers**



Introduce the business to general contractors and other construction organizations. Locate decision-makers, initiate conversations, manage follow-ups, and complete the paperwork needed to become an approved subcontractor.



Help turn those introductions into opportunities to quote upcoming projects.



**Improve how the business operates**



Explore software that can support plan review, quantity takeoffs, document handling, and bid preparation. Compare options, test their usefulness, and explain your findings in practical terms.



You may also use AI assistants, coding agents, and automation tools to simplify recurring work. Programming knowledge is an advantage, but curiosity and the ability to learn are more important.



Coordinate material quotation requests with suppliers and keep pricing information accessible to the estimating team. An experienced estimator will remain responsible for the technical accuracy of estimates.



**Keep people and priorities aligned**



Collect updates from team members, monitor commitments, and give the owner a clear daily picture of completed work, outstanding issues, and decisions needed.



Maintain useful records, write procedures, coordinate tasks, and take on additional research or support assignments as priorities develop.



## The Qualities We Need



- **Depth of understanding.** You can make sense of complicated subjects and identify the details that affect a decision.

- **A record of meaningful accomplishment.** You have tackled something challenging and can describe your individual contribution and the outcome.

- **Self-directed learning.** You know how to investigate, experiment, troubleshoot, and recognize when you need more information.

- **Clear professional English.** You can explain ideas in writing and hold confident conversations with U.S. contacts.

- **Willingness to initiate calls.** Contacting prospective hires, contractors, and suppliers will be a regular part of the position.

- **Dependable execution.** You organize your workload, communicate obstacles early, and complete commitments.

- **Adaptability.** You are comfortable switching between people-focused work, detailed research, technology, and administration.



A strong academic background is welcome, particularly in computer science, engineering, or another demanding analytical discipline. We will also consider substantial evidence of ability developed through employment, independent projects, or other experience.



## Experience That Would Be Useful



Previous exposure to recruitment, executive assistance, operations, sales outreach, construction, or supplier management would help.



Experience with programming, AI-assisted development, workflow automation, or building your own software projects is also valuable.



These are advantages rather than prerequisites. We are interested in your capacity to take responsibility and master unfamiliar work.



## Schedule and Expectations



You must be based in the Philippines and able to maintain a full-time schedule that follows U.S. working hours. You will need a dependable computer, consistent internet access, and a suitable space for business calls.



The position uses Hubstaff for time tracking and requires a brief written progress report each working day.
